fields.System.Title: FDN-506 — Retire an empty location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to retire a location that no longer exists physically,
so that the system stops suggesting it, without losing the history that references it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an empty location, when I retire it, then it becomes unusable for any new
  • operation.
  • - Given a location holding stock, when I retire it, then it is rejected with the
  • stock listed.
  • - Given a retired location, then historical movements referencing it still resolve.
  • - Given any location, then there is no endpoint that hard deletes it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | location |
| Risks | Hard delete orphans history ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
